units.source_text: 风俗歌：“鸳鸯来，沉凫来，鸭子也到原池来。

en.t: A folk song: “The mandarin ducks come, the diving ducks come, and the ducklings too come to the meadow pond.

units.source_text: 蕴藻不可连根采，看它渐渐长大来，看它渐渐长大来。”

en.t: Do not pull up the water plants by the roots; watch them slowly grow, watch them slowly grow.”
